blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the jackpots in the Super Lotto 6/49 and Lotto 6/42 draws on Thursday, Sept. 24, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Super Lotto 6/49 winning combination was 30-39-34-17-47-11 for a jackpot of ₱25.4 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Lotto 6/42 winning combination was 01-36-07-23-15-03 for a jackpot of ₱58.29 million. No ticket matched all six numbers.
